channel.name: ORU R01 to FHIR Bundle
channel.description: Demo oru2fhir: an ORU^R01 (POST ER7 to /oru/, port 8081) becomes a FHIR R4 transaction Bundle conforming to the example profiles in /fhir-volume/ig. Seven FHIR Profile Mapper steps, with no FML or mapping script. The HTTP response is the Bundle.
